battery.name: articulated_v1
battery.description: 12 articulated-object prompts (URDF + bpy link meshes), 4 per tier.  must_have items name the joints the judge/FK sweep must verify.

prompts.prompt: a kitchen wall cabinet with a single hinged door that swings open 110 degrees
must_have: one door on a vertical hinge axis
door swings outward up to 110 degrees

prompts.prompt: a bedside drawer unit with two drawers that slide out
must_have: drawers pull out at least 30 cm

prompts.prompt: a laptop whose screen lid opens from closed to 135 degrees on a hinge at the back edge
must_have: revolute hinge along the back edge

prompts.prompt: a pair of scissors with two blades pivoting about a central screw
must_have: one revolute pivot at the screw

prompts.prompt: a folding chair whose seat lifts up and whose front legs pivot toward the back legs to fold flat
must_have: front leg frame pivoting about a cross bar

prompts.prompt: a desk lamp with a round base, a lower arm that pivots at the base and an upper arm that pivots at the elbow, ending in a shade
a metal toolbox with a lid hinged along the back edge and a fold-down carry handle on top of the lid
must_have: lid hinged at the rear edge

prompts.prompt: a wheelbarrow with a spinning front wheel and a tray that tips forward on its axle to dump
must_have: front wheel on a continuous axle joint

prompts.prompt: a house door in its frame with hinges, a lever handle that rotates down 40 degrees, and a latch bolt that retracts when the handle turns
a wooden treasure chest with a domed lid on rear hinges, a hasp that flips over a staple, and a small inner tray that slides sideways
an office swivel chair with a five-star base on casters, a gas lift that raises the seat, a seat that swivels, and a backrest that tilts back
must_have: five-arm base with five caster wheels

prompts.prompt: a bicycle front wheel and fork on a repair stand, with the wheel spinning on its axle, the fork turning about the steering tube, and a brake caliper whose arms pinch the rim
must_have: spoked wheel on a continuous axle joint
fork on a steering revolute joint
two brake arms pivoting toward the rim
